evidence.excerpt: Synthetic scenario: match notes across several bouts describe repeated first attacks and combinations that keep opponents defending. The athlete secures and maintains a preferred sleeve-and-lapel grip, attacks at a sustained pace, and rarely follows exchanges to the ground. Their scoring attacks repeatedly use Ashi-waza.

evidence.excerpt: Synthetic scenario: supplied match notes show the athlete attacks when openings appear and also scores from opponents' committed attacks. They change grips based on the opponent, use both patient setup and quick attack sequences, regularly use groundwork as a secondary route, and score with both Te-waza and Ashi-waza.
